# Extracted copies

**History (2026-10-21).** These are copies of the v1 documents. The current sources are the Markdown files in `docs/specs/v2/`; do not edit these.

Plain-text copies of the v1 source documents in `docs/specs/`, for searching and quick reading.

- `*.txt`: text of each PDF (`pdftotext -layout`). Diagrams are not included; open the PDF for those.
- `component_values_*.csv`: one file per sheet of `Rovem_Component_Values.xlsx`, as calculated values.

These copies are history. Do not regenerate them; edit `docs/specs/v2/` instead.
